experiment_data.notes: Pipeline split: cuda:3 (PID 222783) runs low+default configs, cuda:2 (PID 226113) runs high_t10_p095. Checkpoint mechanism ensures no duplicate work. cuda:3 will auto-skip high phase. Total ETA ~5.5h (was 11.3h). tmux: high_temp (cuda:2). Log: /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/logs/high_temp_cuda2.log
